sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Artwork viewer: the info panel says what is on screen — "Shown: 1200 px rendition · 1200 × 1500 px", plus the file size and type ("412 KB JPEG") when they are known without asking the archive: from the image cache, or once the original has been downloaded. An "Original" line gives the original's pixel size and file size after a download. Setting: Viewer: show the image's pixel size and file size (on by default). Never makes a request.

Artwork viewer: D (or the Download button) saves the image's original file, named like Art Station does — "04 Other opened gatefold cover, inside left.jpg": its position, its types ("none" when untyped) and its comment. One request per press; the result shows at the bottom left of the image.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: _artViewerLoadFirst() resolves {src, url} so the panel can name the rendition (img.dataset.artvUrl); _artViewerShowFacts(), _artViewerFileInfo (session map of file sizes, by protocol-less URL), _artViewerDownload() and _artViewerDownloadName(); _artGmFetchBlob() takes an optional timeout (the download allows 5 minutes).

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Artwork viewer: F (or the Fullscreen button) puts the viewer into the browser's real fullscreen, without tabs or address bar, and back. Esc leaves fullscreen first and closes the viewer on the next press; closing the viewer always leaves fullscreen.

Artwork viewer: B cycles the background behind the image — dark, light (for dark scans) and a checkerboard (to see where a PNG is transparent). The pick is remembered until the new setting "Viewer: image background" is changed.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Artwork viewer: R (or the Rotate button) turns the image a quarter turn clockwise, Shift+R anticlockwise — for sideways scans such as spines, OBI strips and booklets. The turned image is fitted to the area and pans to every edge like any other. View only: nothing is changed in the archive, and the next image starts upright.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Artwork viewer: drag to pan. The new setting "Viewer: move a zoomed image by" chooses "follow" (the image follows the mouse, as before) or "drag" (it stays put until dragged with the mouse button held; the wheel then zooms keeping the spot under the pointer in place). A click without moving toggles 2× in both.

Artwork viewer: the bar shows the zoom as screen pixels per image pixel ("48 %" when a 1200 px image is fitted, "100 %" at actual size), and 1 shows the image at its actual pixels — also the large image once it replaces the thumbnail.
Artwork viewer on a touch screen: two fingers pinch to zoom, about the spot between them; one finger drags a zoomed image. Unzoomed, a one-finger swipe still steps to the next image.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Viewer zoom core: _artViewerGeom() knows the rotation and the fit factor k; _artViewerSetLevel(), _artViewerOverhang(), _artViewerTranslate() and one anchor rule, _artViewerPanAnchor(), for a drag, a pinch and a zoom held at the pointer; the click a drag or pinch ends with is swallowed by a one-shot flag (st.swallowClick), not a time window. The stage is touch-action: none. Shared test set-up tests/support/artViewerFixture.js; new specs art-viewer-extras.spec.js and art-viewer-extras.mobile.spec.js; mutation list scripts/mutations/art-viewer-extras.json (20 entries).

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Artwork viewer: a zoomed image can now be panned to every edge, and the bottom of a tall image is no longer cut off. A large image taller than the viewer's image area was laid out at its full natural height and cropped at the bottom, even unzoomed (measured: a 1200 × 1500 px image ended about 500 px below the visible area); no mouse position could bring that part into view. The image is now fitted to the area on every side, and when zoomed, moving the mouse toward a side pans the image until its edge is in view, and no further. Getting near the side is enough, and a fast move past it (onto the filmstrip or the info panel) still pans all the way. The fit also follows window resizes. Applies to the viewer of the CAA/EAA column, the gallery, and the release and event pages' art sections.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Artwork viewer: the image is out of flow and sized in px by _artViewerFit() from the stage's geometry (_artViewerGeom(), cached in st.geom; gutters from --mb-artv-gx/--mb-artv-gy); the pan is a clamped translate (_artViewerPanFromPointer(), _ART_VIEWER_PAN_EDGE, _artViewerApplyTransform()) instead of a transform-origin at the pointer. New spec tests/fixtures/art-viewer-pan.spec.js, serving images with a real natural size; mutation list scripts/mutations/art-viewer-pan.json.
